# Security policy

## Supported version

Security fixes are applied to the latest version on the `main` branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not file a public issue for a vulnerability that could damage local
files, corrupt saves, execute unintended native code or compromise dependency
integrity. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature for the
repository instead.

Include the affected commit, reproduction steps, impact and any suggested
mitigation. Reports should receive an initial acknowledgement within seven
days. There is currently no bug-bounty programme.

Ordinary crashes, gameplay bugs and malformed-but-contained save failures may
be reported through the public issue tracker.
